title.en: Black Rock Coffee Bar adds three Arizona shops
title.zh: Black Rock Coffee Bar 亞利桑那新增三家店

excerpt.en: Black Rock Coffee Bar is preparing openings in Glendale, Chandler and Prescott Valley. The first shop is expected in June, with two more planned for July.
excerpt.zh: Black Rock Coffee Bar 正準備在 Glendale、Chandler 與 Prescott Valley 開新店。首家預計 6 月開幕，另外兩家計畫在 7 月接續登場。

body.en: Black Rock Coffee Bar is adding three more Arizona locations as the coffee chain continues building its footprint in the state. The next shop is planned for 5937 N. 91st Ave., Suite 130, in Glendale, with an opening expected in June.
body.zh: Black Rock Coffee Bar 正在亞利桑那新增三家據點，延續這家咖啡連鎖品牌在州內的擴張。下一家店計畫設於 Glendale 的 5937 N. 91st Ave., Suite 130，預計 6 月開幕。

body.en: Two more Arizona stores are scheduled to follow in July. One is planned at 3103 S. McQueen Road in Chandler, and another is planned at 6272 E. 2nd Street in Prescott Valley.
body.zh: 另外兩家亞利桑那門市預定在 7 月接續開出。其中一家位於 Chandler 的 3103 S. McQueen Road，另一家位於 Prescott Valley 的 6272 E. 2nd Street。

body.en: The expansion gives customers in three different Arizona communities another place for coffee drinks, cold brew, tea, smoothies, energy beverages and protein options. The menu also includes breakfast items such as burritos, sandwiches, bagels, muffins and other baked goods.
body.zh: 這波展店將讓三個亞利桑那社區的顧客多一個選擇，可購買咖啡飲品、冷萃咖啡、茶、冰沙、能量飲料與蛋白質飲品。菜單也提供早餐品項，包括 burrito、三明治、貝果、馬芬與其他烘焙食品。

body.en: Black Rock began in Oregon in 2008 under founder Jeff Hernandez. The company has grown from one coffee stand into a chain with more than 150 locations across the United States, and Arizona remains part of that wider growth plan.
body.zh: Black Rock 由 Jeff Hernandez 於 2008 年在 Oregon 創立。公司從一個咖啡攤發展成全美超過 150 家店的連鎖品牌，而亞利桑那仍是其美國展店計畫的一部分。

title.en: Atashi Yokocho planned for Scottsdale development
title.zh: Atashi Yokocho 計畫進駐 Scottsdale 開發案

excerpt.en: Atashi Yokocho is planned for The Sydney at 7339 E. McDonald Drive in Scottsdale. The Japanese inspired dining project is expected to open in 2028 with about 15 restaurant concepts.
excerpt.zh: Atashi Yokocho 計畫進駐 Scottsdale 的 The Sydney，地址為 7339 E. McDonald Drive。這個日本風格餐飲項目預計 2028 年開幕，將包含約 15 個餐廳概念。

body.en: Atashi Yokocho is planned for The Sydney, a large mixed use project at 7339 E. McDonald Drive in Scottsdale. Restaurateur Huy Truong is preparing the Japanese inspired dining destination for a 2028 opening near Loop 101 and Pima Road.
body.zh: Atashi Yokocho 計畫落腳 The Sydney，這是 Scottsdale 一個大型綜合用途開發案，地址為 7339 E. McDonald Drive。餐飲業者 Huy Truong 正籌備這個日本風格餐飲項目，預計 2028 年在 Loop 101 與 Pima Road 附近開幕。

body.en: The project takes cues from Japan's yokocho dining culture, where small restaurants and bars are grouped along narrow alleyways. In Scottsdale, the plan calls for about 15 separate eateries operating inside one shared location.
body.zh: 這個項目的靈感來自日本的 yokocho 飲食文化，也就是在狹窄巷弄中聚集小餐館與酒吧的形式。Scottsdale 版本計畫在同一個空間內設置約 15 個獨立餐飲概念。

body.en: Truong has already brought several Japanese dining brands to the Valley. His portfolio includes multiple Mensho Ramen locations, tied to the Michelin recognized Tokyo ramen concept, and Udon Shin, a Japanese noodle restaurant that recently opened in Mesa.
body.zh: Truong 先前已把多個日本餐飲品牌帶到 Valley。他的餐飲組合包括多家 Mensho Ramen，該品牌與 Tokyo 的米其林認可拉麵概念有關，也包括近期在 Mesa 開幕的日本麵食餐廳 Udon Shin。

body.en: Atashi Yokocho is expected to cover a broad range of Japanese food. Planned offerings include ramen, sushi, tempura, yakitori, yakiniku, kaiseki and regional dishes.
body.zh: Atashi Yokocho 預計涵蓋多種類型的日本料理。規劃中的品項包括拉麵、壽司、天婦羅、yakitori 串燒、yakiniku 燒肉、kaiseki 懷石料理與地方特色菜。

body.en: The restaurant spaces may vary in size, from small rooms seating about eight people to larger areas for as many as 50 guests. Truong is also considering rotating pop ups, which could give Japanese operators limited runs in front of Arizona diners.
body.zh: 各餐飲空間大小可能不同，小型座位區約可容納八人，較大的區域可容納最多 50 人。Truong 也在研究輪替 pop up 的可能性，讓日本餐飲業者以限期形式面向亞利桑那食客。

title.en: Luna Grill plans three more Phoenix area restaurants
title.zh: Luna Grill 計畫再開三家鳳凰城地區餐廳

excerpt.en: Luna Grill expects to open at least three more restaurants in the Phoenix area before the end of 2026. The planned locations include Tempe, Avondale and north Phoenix.
excerpt.zh: Luna Grill 預計在 2026 年底前於鳳凰城地區至少再開三家餐廳。計畫地點包括 Tempe、Avondale 與 north Phoenix。

body.en: Luna Grill is preparing another round of growth in metro Phoenix, with at least three restaurants planned before the end of 2026. The San Diego based chain is targeting Tempe, Avondale and north Phoenix for the new openings.
body.zh: Luna Grill 正準備在大鳳凰城地區展開下一波擴張，計畫在 2026 年底前至少開出三家餐廳。這家總部位於 San Diego 的連鎖品牌鎖定 Tempe、Avondale 與 north Phoenix 作為新據點。

body.en: The north Phoenix restaurant is planned near the area around TSMC's semiconductor campus, where new development has been moving ahead. A Luna Grill location has also been proposed as part of a retail project near Dove Valley Road.
body.zh: north Phoenix 的餐廳預計靠近 TSMC 半導體園區周邊，該區正在持續開發。Dove Valley Road 附近的一個零售開發案中，也曾提出 Luna Grill 據點計畫。

body.en: The company has already entered Arizona with restaurants in Mesa and Gilbert. The next openings would move the brand into more parts of the Valley and give additional communities access to its Mediterranean inspired menu.
body.zh: Luna Grill 已透過 Mesa 與 Gilbert 的門市進入亞利桑那市場。接下來的新店將把品牌帶到 Valley 更多區域，讓更多社區接觸到其地中海風味菜單。

body.en: Luna Grill was founded in 2004 by Sean and Maria Pourteymour. Its menu includes kabobs, bowls, salads, pitas, family meals and other dishes prepared with fresh ingredients and cooked to order.
body.zh: Luna Grill 由 Sean 與 Maria Pourteymour 於 2004 年創立。菜單包括 kabob 烤肉串、碗餐、沙拉、pita、家庭餐與其他以新鮮食材現點現做的餐點。

body.en: The brand operates more than 50 restaurants in California, Texas and Arizona. Exact opening dates for the Tempe, Avondale and north Phoenix locations have not been announced, but the company expects them to arrive by the end of 2026.
body.zh: 這個品牌目前在 California、Texas 與 Arizona 經營超過 50 家餐廳。Tempe、Avondale 與 north Phoenix 新店的確切開幕日期尚未公布，但公司預計會在 2026 年底前開出。

title.en: Grandioso targets mid July opening on Grand Avenue
title.zh: Grandioso 目標 7 月中旬在 Grand Avenue 開幕

excerpt.en: Grandioso is planned for 1227 Grand Ave in Phoenix, with Justin Piazza aiming for a summer opening. The bar focused restaurant will serve several pizza styles along with drinks, wings, appetizers and panino sandwiches.
excerpt.zh: Grandioso 計畫設於 Phoenix 的 1227 Grand Ave，Justin Piazza 目標在夏季開幕。這家以酒吧氛圍為主的餐廳將供應多種披薩，並提供飲品、烤雞翅、前菜與 panino 三明治。

body.en: Grandioso is planned for 1227 Grand Ave in Phoenix, where restaurateur and pizzaiolo Justin Piazza is preparing a summer opening. The team has looked at July 1, but Piazza now sees July 15 as the more likely opening date.
body.zh: Grandioso 計畫設於 Phoenix 的 1227 Grand Ave，餐飲業者與披薩師 Justin Piazza 正籌備夏季開幕。團隊曾考慮 7 月 1 日開店，但 Piazza 目前認為 7 月 15 日更可能成為正式日期。

body.en: The restaurant is being built around pizza, drinks and a neighborhood bar feel connected to the Grand Avenue arts scene. Piazza, known for La Piazza Al Forno and earlier downtown Phoenix projects, is shaping Grandioso as a place for slices, drinks and hanging out rather than formal table service.
body.zh: 這家餐廳將以披薩、飲品與鄰里酒吧氛圍為核心，並與 Grand Avenue 的藝術社群連結。Piazza 以 La Piazza Al Forno 及過去的 downtown Phoenix 項目聞名，他正把 Grandioso 打造成供人吃披薩、喝飲料與停留的空間，而非傳統桌邊服務餐廳。

body.en: Grandioso is expected to serve four pizza styles. The lineup includes traditional New York style pizza, Roman taglio squares, Detroit style pan pizza and thin tavern style pies with a crisp texture.
body.zh: Grandioso 預計供應四種披薩風格。菜單包括傳統 New York style pizza、Roman taglio 方形披薩、Detroit style pan pizza，以及薄而酥脆的 tavern style 披薩。

body.en: The menu will go beyond pizza with a full bar program, baked wings, appetizers and panino style sandwiches. The operating model is planned as fast casual and bar oriented, giving customers a more informal option on the Grand Avenue corridor.
body.zh: 披薩之外，菜單還將包括完整酒吧飲品、烤雞翅、前菜與 panino style 三明治。營運模式規劃為 fast casual 並偏向酒吧，為 Grand Avenue 走廊提供一個較輕鬆的用餐選擇。

body.en: Piazza returned to Phoenix and found Grand Avenue to be the right fit because of its people, atmosphere and creative activity. The space is expected to include murals inside and outside by Arizona artists, along with a pool table, jukebox and late night energy.
body.zh: Piazza 回到 Phoenix 後，因為當地居民、氛圍與創意活動而認為 Grand Avenue 適合這個項目。店內外預計會有亞利桑那藝術家創作的壁畫，並設置撞球桌、jukebox 與深夜時段的活動氣氛。

title.en: Angry Crab Shack opens Chandler restaurant June 11
title.zh: Angry Crab Shack 6 月 11 日在 Chandler 開店

excerpt.en: Angry Crab Shack is opening a new restaurant at 3033 S. Gilbert Road in Chandler. The June 11 celebration will include a spicy wing contest, children's activities and local nonprofit support.
excerpt.zh: Angry Crab Shack 將在 Chandler 的 3033 S. Gilbert Road 開設新餐廳。6 月 11 日的開幕活動將包括辣雞翅比賽、兒童活動，並支持在地非營利組織。

body.en: Angry Crab Shack is opening its newest Arizona restaurant on June 11 at 3033 S. Gilbert Road in Chandler. The Arizona based seafood chain will bring its seafood boils, bold sauces and Asian Cajun flavors to the Southeast Valley.
body.zh: Angry Crab Shack 將於 6 月 11 日在 Chandler 的 3033 S. Gilbert Road 開設最新亞利桑那餐廳。這家亞利桑那本地海鮮連鎖品牌將把海鮮鍋、重口味醬料與 Asian Cajun 風味帶到 Southeast Valley。

body.en: The Chandler restaurant is owned and operated by local franchise partners from the Appiah family. Franchisee Adelaide Appiah said the family is proud to bring the brand's seafood and community focused approach to its own neighborhood.
body.zh: Chandler 餐廳由在地加盟夥伴 Appiah 家族擁有並營運。加盟業者 Adelaide Appiah 表示，家族很高興能把品牌的海鮮餐點與重視社區的經營方式帶到自己的社區。

body.en: The grand opening is planned as a public event rather than a simple first day of service. Chandler police and fire personnel are expected to take part in a spicy wing eating competition, and a DJ will provide music and entertainment.
body.zh: 開幕日規劃成一場公開活動，而不只是一般營業首日。Chandler 警察與消防人員預計參加辣雞翅吃食比賽，現場也會有 DJ 帶來音樂與娛樂。

body.en: Families visiting the opening can expect a balloon artist for children and a spin to win prize table that includes a chance to win a TV. The event will also support local nonprofit organizations.
body.zh: 到場家庭可期待兒童氣球藝術師，以及 spin to win 抽獎桌，獎品包括有機會抽中電視。活動也將支持在地非營利組織。

body.en: The new restaurant will participate in Angry Crab Shack charitable programs tied to veterans, children's hospitals and local food banks. Angry Crab Shack operates 15 locations across Arizona and has more planned for this year.
body.zh: 這家新餐廳也將參與 Angry Crab Shack 的慈善計畫，相關項目支持退伍軍人、兒童醫院與在地食物銀行。Angry Crab Shack 目前在亞利桑那經營 15 家店，並計畫今年繼續增加據點。
